plants.name: Aloe Vera
plants.shortDescription: A succulent plant species of the genus Aloe.
plants.description: Aloe vera is a succulent plant species of the genus Aloe. It grows wild in tropical climates around the world and is cultivated for agricultural and medicinal uses. It is also used for decorative purposes and grows successfully indoors as a potted plant.

plants.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
plants.shortDescription: A popular indoor plant known for its large, glossy leaves.
plants.description: The fiddle leaf fig (Ficus lyrata) is a popular indoor plant known for its large, glossy leaves that resemble the shape of a fiddle or violin. It is native to western Africa and can grow up to 10 feet tall indoors. The fiddle leaf fig requires bright, indirect light and regular watering to thrive.

plants.name: ZZ Plant
plants.shortDescription: A hardy indoor plant with glossy, dark green leaves.
plants.description: The ZZ plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia) is a hardy indoor plant with glossy, dark green leaves. It is native to eastern Africa and can tolerate low light conditions, making it a popular choice for offices and homes. The ZZ plant requires infrequent watering and can survive periods of neglect.
